## Summary

What changes, and why.

## Evidence

For each new or changed claim: the certificate (DRAT proof checked by
drat-trim, dual certificate, colouring checked against the rebuilt edges) or
the argument, and the command that checks it.

## Checks

- [ ] The test files touched, and the fast subset that CI runs, pass.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under *Unreleased*.
- [ ] Mathematical changes are recorded in the research log.
